lead_direct.title: {name} and the Real Name in That House

lead_careful.title: {name} Waited Twenty Years
lead_careful.logline: {name} let twenty years go by without a word. Then, once, with everyone in the room, {name} speaks.

firstLove_direct.title: {name} and a Promise in the Rain
firstLove_direct.logline: {name} can't walk past someone standing in the rain with no umbrella. That once carries a hundred episodes.

firstLove_careful.title: {name} and the Photo in the Drawer
firstLove_careful.logline: {name} put the photo back in the drawer and asked nobody. Which is why nothing was ever finished.

spark_direct.title: {name}, the Second Time
spark_direct.logline: The second time they meet, {name} just asks. One question turns the whole household over.

spark_careful.title: {name} and Them, 1998
spark_careful.logline: {name} and that person passed each other once in 1998. Neither of them knows. Only you do.

second_direct.title: {name} on the Mourner's Card
second_direct.logline: {name}'s name was on the chief mourner's card. {name} sat down, and half the audience changed sides that night.

second_careful.title: {name} Stayed to the End
second_careful.logline: Everyone went home and {name} was still in the corridor. Nobody knew until the final episode.

rival_direct.title: {name}, the Last Line of the Will

rival_careful.title: {name}, a Quiet Inheritance
rival_careful.logline: {name} asks for nothing. The shares keep moving {name}'s way regardless.

bestie_direct.title: {name} Is the Noise in This House
bestie_direct.logline: A quiet house gets loud when {name} walks in. Without that noise it would have fallen down already.

bestie_careful.title: {name} Takes Nobody's Side
bestie_careful.logline: {name} won't take sides, which is why {name} is the only one anyone tells the truth to.

lead_direct.title: {name}, Class 3-1

firstLove_careful.title: {name} and the Letter in the Locker

second_careful.title: {name} Lends You the Notes

rival_careful.title: {name} Already Knew

lead_direct.title: {name} Makes the Debut Line-up

lead_careful.title: Seven Years of {name}
lead_careful.logline: {name} never raises their voice once. The team moves at {name}'s pace regardless.

firstLove_direct.title: {name}, Two in the Morning

firstLove_careful.title: {name} and a Letter Three Years Late
firstLove_careful.logline: {name} never wrote back. The letter is still in {name}'s wallet.

spark_direct.title: {name}, the Dating Story

spark_careful.title: {name} and Them, Bunk Beds

rival_careful.title: {name}, Quietly Number One
rival_careful.logline: {name} asks for nothing. Centre stage keeps drifting {name}'s way anyway.

bestie_direct.title: {name} Is the Noise in This Group
bestie_direct.logline: The practice room flips when {name} walks in. Half the behind-the-scenes views are {name}.
